hero.title: Your notebook. On your phone.
hero.subtitle: Fields, today’s work, harvest, and costs — in one place, in Greek or English.
hero.trust: For olive growers in Greece. Greek and English.

shift.title: From paper to phone
shift.text: What you wrote in a notebook, in WhatsApp, or in your head — now stays in one place and is not forgotten.
shift.paperText: Fields and notes on paper that get lost.
shift.chatText: Work disappears in calls and WhatsApp.
shift.phoneText: The same notes, shared with the owner.

notes.title: Five notes you keep
notes.text: Simple, like a notebook — no complicated menus.
notes.fieldsText: Every grove with a name, size, and season.
notes.todayText: What matters this morning, in plain language.
notes.harvestText: Olive and oil kilos — without digging through paper.
notes.costsText: What you spent and received, per field.
notes.historyText: The story of your grove — what happened, when, and where.

audience.title: For owner and producer — together
audience.ownerText: See every grove without being there. Same picture as the producer.
audience.ownerAlt: Field on the web for the owner
audience.producerText: Know what to do today. Write it down in thirty seconds from the field.

steps.title: Start in three steps
steps.step1Text: Name, size, crop. Enough to begin.
steps.step2Text: Pruning, fertilizer, spray, harvest — what you used to put in the notebook.
steps.step3Text: See today’s list, mark work done, keep a note.

alpha.title: Try it free
alpha.text: During alpha, access is free for real field use. Web and Android.
installSteps: Download the APK to your Android phone.
If Android asks, allow installation from this source.
Create an account or sign in.
alpha.safety: Install only from the official Oleachron page. This is an alpha — some features may change.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. During alpha it is free for people testing it in the field.
faq.a2: Yes for now. We start with olives so the tool stays simple and useful.
faq.a3: No. Field work happens on the phone. The web helps the owner see everything.
faq.a4: Yes. Greek and English — switch languages at the top.
faq.a5: Download it only from this page. Do not install from unknown sources.
faq.a6: Yes. Send a demo request or email us.
